title: "Explore the Data: Interactive Player Explorer"
---

## Interactive Player Explorer

Use the interactive visualization below to investigate how individual player performance varies with age across Europe's top five domestic soccer leagues during the 2025–2026 season.

### How to Use This Graphic
* **Filter by League & Position:** Use the dropdown filters below to narrow the players shown. You can choose one or more leagues and positions, or leave them empty to view all players.
* **Hover for Details:** Move your cursor over any marker to see the player's name, age, squad, league, position, minutes played, goals, assists, and goal contributions per 90.
* **Zoom & Pan:** Click and drag on any region of the plot to zoom in. Use the top-right Plotly toolbar to pan, or double-click anywhere on the plot area to reset the zoom.

```{r}
#| label: setup-explore
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)

players_clean <- read_csv("data/players_data_light-2025_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(Gls), !is.na(Ast), !is.na(`90s`), `90s` > 0) |>
  mutate(
    ga_per_90 = round((Gls + Ast) / `90s`, 2),
    League = sub("^[a-z]{2} ", "", Comp)
  )

sd <- SharedData$new(players_clean)

p <- plot_ly(
  sd,
  x = ~Age,
  y = ~ga_per_90,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(
    size = 7,
    opacity = 0.55,
    color = "#1d3557"
  ),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", Player, "</b>",
    "<br>Age: ", Age,
    "<br>Squad: ", Squad,
    "<br>League: ", League,
    "<br>Position: ", Pos,
    "<br>Minutes: ", format(Min, big.mark = ","),
    "<br>Goals: ", Gls,
    "<br>Assists: ", Ast,
    "<br>Goal Contributions / 90: ", ga_per_90
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Age (Years)",
      dtick = 2
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Goal Contributions per 90 (Gls + Ast / 90s)",
      range = c(-0.1, 3.5)
    ),
    hovermode = "closest"
  )

bscols(
  widths = c(3, 9),
  list(
    filter_select("filter_league", "Filter by League:", sd, ~League),
    filter_select("filter_pos", "Filter by Position:", sd, ~Pos)
  ),
  p
)
```

### Data Source
Data was retrieved from Kaggle: [Football Players Statistics (2025–2026)](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/hubertsidorowicz/football-players-stats-2025-2026) by Hubert Sidorowicz, sourced from FBref.
